item.title: Whiskers 0.8.46
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.46

### Local Whisper Models

  • Improved local Whisper transcription reliability with a newer on-device runtime
  • Added support for the large-v3-turbo Whisper model for stronger local transcription quality
  • Improved local model validation so incomplete or changed model files are caught before dictation starts

    • ### Onboarding & Permissions

  • Streamlined onboarding so setup starts with the required permissions and ends with a guided dictation test
  • Added clearer permission recovery steps, including reveal-in-Finder help when macOS needs you to add Whiskers manually
  • Improved the practice dictation step so successful inserted text is detected more reliably

    • ### Screen Awareness

  • Improved Screen Awareness matching for file names, code symbols, API routes, issue numbers, and technical terms
  • Improved visible-text handling so alternate OCR readings can help AI enhancement choose the right spelling

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed onboarding so downloading a model does not finish setup before you complete the guided dictation step
  • Fixed the settings window close button so Whiskers stays available from the menu bar
